config.desc.RowPerPage: Number of rows to display per page on subpages with many items. If you feel lag in the menu, lower this value and then restart the handbook.
config.desc.ShowHandbookKey: Press this key to display the perfection handbook.
config.desc.AutoExportPeriod: Auto-export a new perfection card periodically, set to 0 to disable.
config.desc.RemindersToggleKey: Press this key to toggle the reminders HUD
config.desc.RemindersEditModifierKey: While in the perfection handbook, hold this key and click on an entry to add it to your reminders
config.desc.RemindersMaxCount: The maximum number of reminders you can have at a time, new reminders will push out old reminders
config.desc.RemindersDefaultExpanded: Change whether sub-reminders (such as crafting recipe ingredients) will be displayed by default
config.desc.RemindersHUDPosition: Change where the remidners HUD goes on screen.
